defs.def: the father or mother of your father or mother 祖父；祖母；外祖父；外祖母

ex.s: We learn to tell the truth, even when lying is self-serving; we help a grandparent even when it is inconvenient.
ex.t: 我们学会说实话，即使撒谎对自己有利；我们在不方便的时候也会帮助祖父母。

ex.s: During my last winter holiday, I went to countryside with my father to visit my grandparents.
ex.t: 去年寒假期间，我和父亲一起回乡下看望祖父母。

ex.s: My two sets of grandparents lived in Colorado and North Dakota, and my parents decided to spend a few weeks driving to those states and seeing all the sights along the way.
ex.t: 如果有一户陌生的家庭出现在她的门前台阶上，妈妈会很高兴的。

ex.s: In fact, good friends can share up to 1% of the same genes - as much as we might share with our great-great-great grandparents!
ex.t: 事实上，好朋友可以共享多达1%的相同基因——和我们与曾曾曾祖父母共享的基因一样多！

ex.s: They could be your parents or grandparents, their friends or work colleagues.
ex.t: 他们可能是你的父母或祖父母，他们的朋友或工作同事。

ex.s: Ring-ring!” That once-familiar sound in your home can only mean one thing: your grandparents are calling.
ex.t: 铃铃铃！那个曾经熟悉的声音在你家里响起只能意味着一件事：你的祖父母来电话了。

ex.s: They encounter numerous characters such as their departed grandparents, trees that hate mankind, the greedy and ugly Luxuries, and children waiting to be born.
ex.t: 他们遇到了许多角色，如已故的祖父母、憎恨人类的树木、贪婪丑陋的奢华，以及等待着出生的孩子们。

ex.s: I’ll visit my grandparents in December.
ex.t: 我十二月份去看望我的祖父母。
